material.source: Native dark reference plates: root32, first card57, second card68. Neutral-gallery phone film: root32, first card59, second header73. Fit uses the renderer regular dark emission32, transmission0.447 and lift1; second backdrop is inferred from its baseline face, with the first card footprint fraction held fixed. Gamma fit checked by MorphRecorder dark-fit.mov, gamma1.07: root32, first57, second header69 vs native68 at x180-220/y348-355pt. Median phone samples use variable-PTS frames26.746333 and39.948567s; native reference is3x, movie resampled1x.

close_body_width_alignment.method: Fit visible body width at native22.50..22.72s, interpolating actual variable film PTS; mask min(R,G)>246 at x40..365/y110..490. No geometry or spring fit.
